references.text: Jesus gives further instructions to the twelve after granting them power over unclean spirits, showing how they should use this authority.
Mark describes how Jesus called the twelve to himself and gave them power to drive out demons, paralleling Matthew's account of the delegation of authority.
Luke also tells how Jesus gave the twelve power and authority over all demons and to heal diseases, which resembles the event in Matthew.
Luke again mentions that Jesus gives the twelve power and authority over all demons and to cure diseases, as a parallel to Matthew 10:1.
The Acts of the Apostles shows how the disciples used the power over diseases and unclean spirits that Jesus had given them, in line with his instructions.
